# Powerhouse Roasters

> Small-batch coffee roastery on a family farm in Torrington, Wyoming. Family-owned by Wes and Michelle. Roasts six coffees, ships direct to consumers across the contiguous United States, and sells wholesale to cafés, offices, and retail partners.

Powerhouse Roasters roasts coffee in small batches on their working farm rather than in a large commercial facility. The brand's tagline is "Wyoming roasted. Power in every pour." Founded after Wes began roasting on a small home roaster his kids gave him for Christmas.

## Key facts

- Location: Torrington, Wyoming, USA
- Phone: (307) 401-2441
- Email: info@powerhouseroasters.com
- Shipping: contiguous United States only (48 states); does not currently ship to Alaska, Hawaii, or internationally
- Shipping speed: guaranteed within 4 business days of purchase, typically within 2
- Free shipping on orders of $75 or more
- Return policy: full refund within 30 days of delivery, no questions asked, no need to return the product
- Every coffee is available as Whole Bean or Ground, and as a one-time purchase or a recurring Subscribe & Save order (discounted price, choice of delivery frequency)
- Wholesale accounts available for cafés, offices, restaurants, hospitality, and retail — tiered volume pricing, contact for rates

## Products (all $19.00 for a 12 oz / 340 g bag)

- Full Power Dark — medium-dark roast, dark chocolate, roasted nuts, heavy body. Brazil + Sumatra beans.
- Range Line Roast — medium roast, milk chocolate, caramel, balanced finish. The brand's most-reordered, everyday coffee. Brazil + Guatemala + Colombia beans.
- Brazil — medium roast, chocolate, toasted almond, caramel, low acidity.
- Guatemala — medium roast, milk chocolate, toffee, red apple, clean and crisp. Huehuetenango, washed process.
- Ethiopia — light roast, citrus, floral notes, clean sweetness. Washed process.
- Stillwater Decaf — medium roast decaf, cocoa, brown sugar, toasted nuts, full character without caffeine.
